name: You
source:
You play the role of the unnamed protagonist, a former male stripper who aims to becomes the world's best mahjong player. A former mahjong champion sees potential in your play, and offers your choice of his three daughters. The sisters have their doubts, but nonetheless grant the chance to prove yourself in games of strip mahjong. Although he defeats each of them, our protagonist balks at the offer of marriage.

Now that he's become friendly with the sisters, they continue to play against one another. While they know he is the strongest player they have ever seen, he still loses sometimes - perhaps even on purpose in order to show off more than just his gaming skills.
